comment: Which committed artifact each `content_hash` in block-manifest.json pins.
Today the manifest cites nothing -- every T1 item is unmet with
`no_evidence`, the honest statement that no klt-gradable envelope exists
in this repo yet (see signoff/README.md) -- so this map is empty. The
first citation added to block-manifest.json must add its entry here in the
same PR: klt compares a manifest pin against the *cited envelope's own*
provenance.input.content_hash -- it never looks at the repo file the hash
is supposed to be the hash *of*. So a pin can go stale in two independent
ways, and only one of them is klt's business:
1. the cited envelope ran against a different revision than the pin
2. the pinned artifact itself changed in the repo since the pin was
written, so the pin no longer describes current sources at all
(klt cannot catch this -- it never reads the artifact).
This file closes (2): signoff/check_signoff.py re-hashes every path below
and fails when it no longer equals the manifest's pin for that item. It is
stdlib-only and PDK-free, so it runs in the offline half of the CI
signoff job with no klt and no network -- see signoff/README.md.
